mobile.public.transparency.title: Moderation transparency
mobile.public.transparency.lead: Aggregated totals by period, without identities, individual reasons or case content.

mobile.public.transparency.empty: No aggregated period is available yet.
mobile.public.transparency.legalLead: Legal deadlines (ordinance No. {{ordinance}}): a decision within {{decisionHours}} h for harassment or content harmful to a minor, removal within {{removalHours}} h for a deepfake or prohibited AI content. Each period counts the deadlines that fell on that day; it publishes them only from {{count}} deadlines and {{count}} distinct authors, and a number below {{count}} is not given.
mobile.public.legal.journal: Official Journal: Law No. 025/2023 of 12 July 2023
mobile.public.legal.about.title: One network, several contexts
mobile.public.legal.about.lead: {{brand}} connects the public life of the network with contributions voluntarily shared by its child networks.
mobile.public.legal.about.purpose.title: People keep their social identity
mobile.public.legal.about.purpose.body: Each person chooses a handle and a profile. An additional network adds a participation context; it does not create a second person.
mobile.public.legal.about.contexts.title: Making content public remains a choice
mobile.public.legal.about.contexts.body: Content restricted to a closed network is not shown in this public view. Distribution on {{brand}} requires an explicit choice and a public audience; withdrawal of that distribution also applies here.
mobile.public.legal.about.trust.title: Trust indicators are calculated
mobile.public.legal.about.trust.body: Official describes the trust attributed to an institutional page. Verified and Public agent rely on active identity evidence. Community describes participation without those additional proofs. These indicators do not guarantee a publication’s truthfulness.

mobile.public.legal.legal.law.title: Data protection
mobile.public.legal.legal.law.body: The Gabonese framework includes Law No. 001/2011, amended by Law No. 025/2023 of 12 July 2023. APDPVP procedures and the applicability of the GDPR, particularly Article 3, must be assessed with legal counsel according to the processing and people concerned.
mobile.public.legal.legal.publication.bo: Each author is responsible for the content they share and the audience they choose. Reports and appeals use the service controls; the publisher contact remains available for requests that cannot be handled in your account. This information is not an APDPVP approval or official validation of data location.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.title: Privacy and your choices
mobile.public.legal.privacy.lead: Understand what is public and find the controls for your profile, consents and data.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.profile.body: Reading without an account shows only admitted public projections: open publications, reduced profiles and Official pages. Private mode and profile withdrawal apply across the engine. Withdrawing a profile does not automatically delete its publications; publication withdrawal and data rights are separate controls.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.cookies.body: Cookies specific to {{brand}} correlate the browser session with server rendering. They support sign-in and its closure. Optional usage measurement requires specific consent; reading public content does not grant it.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.rights.title: Your data controls
mobile.public.legal.privacy.rights.body: My data provides access to preferences, consent records, notifications, export and erasure requests, and appeals. It remains accessible if the network suspends you. You can edit profile information, withdraw optional consent or write to admin@ntsagui.com to request access, rectification, objection, restriction or erasure. Describe the request and account concerned; information necessary to verify that you are the account holder may be requested. You may also contact the competent data protection authority.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.controller.b:
ANTSIA is published by NTSAGUI DIGITAL, SARL, the operator responsible for the service and the processing described here. Registered office: Batterie IV, rue des Résidences — BP 638, Libreville, Gabon.
For a request about your data, write to admin@ntsagui.com and include “ANTSIA” and your account handle. Do not send a password or sign-in code.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.data.title: Data used and its purpose
mobile.public.legal.privacy.data.body:
The service uses your sign-in identifier, the profile information you provide, memberships, preferences and consent records. When you choose Identité.ga, ANTSIA receives the information authorised during sign-in; your Identité.ga password is entered with that provider.
Your posts, media, comments, reactions, connections, messages and service requests are processed when you use the corresponding features. They support your account and interactions. Technical session information and security records protect access, limit abuse and support the handling of reports.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.recipients.b:
The recipients of your content depend on the audience and context you choose: public, network, group or conversation. Authorised operations and moderation staff access the information necessary for their duties.
Vercel hosts the web application; Convex provides the backend, application authentication and storage. Identité.ga is involved when you choose that sign-in method. Code and notification delivery services are involved according to the channel used and your preferences. These cloud services may process data outside Gabon. Sharing a publisher with another application does not give that application access to your data.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.retention.bo:
Account information and durable content remain necessary while you keep your account or the relevant content. You can edit your profile, withdraw your content and request account erasure in My data.
An erasure request has a 30-day grace period during which it can be cancelled, followed by staged processing of the relevant personal data and files. Completion is shown in the request status; erasure is not instantaneous when you click.
A personal export is available for 24 hours. Read notifications become eligible for purging 180 days after they are read; unread notifications after 365 days from creation. Scheduled jobs perform these purges in batches. Any retention obligations and disputes are assessed for the data concerned; special retention must be justified.
mobile.public.legal.privacy.device.title: On iPhone and Android
mobile.public.legal.privacy.device.body:
Identité.ga sign-in opens in the system browser and then returns to ANTSIA. The application keeps session information in the phone’s secure storage. Signing out closes the application session.
Access to photos, the camera or microphone depends on the features used and the phone permissions you grant. You can change these permissions in system settings. Refusing a permission limits the feature that needs it.
